title: The δ* gap H(ρ)/(β log n) IS the entropy-rate of the census numerator: ceiling distance to capacity = (log₂ I_∞)/(β log₂ n) via method-of-types
connection: The conjectured pin δ*=1−ρ−H(ρ)/(β log₂ n) is reconstructed from the census: kkh26_gap_identity proves the march ceiling sits EXACTLY (2m−1)/n=Θ(1/2^μ) below capacity; kkh26_count_poly_in_n + choose_ge_two_rpow_entropy_div prove the census numerator C(2^μ,r)≥2^{2^μ·H(r/2^μ)}/(2^μ+1), i.e. log₂ I_∞≈2^μ·H(ρ). The pin fires (F1) when I_∞=q·ε*≈n, i.e. 2^μ·H(ρ)≈log₂ n+(gap)·(β log₂ n); solving gives gap=H(ρ)/(β log n). why_insightful: Shows the headline constant H(ρ)/β is not mysterious-analytic but forced by C(n,ρn)≈2^{nH(ρ)} method-of-types on the census — reducing the prize constant to a binomial entropy fact already in-tree, isolating exactly the two binomial-tail inequalities.
